title: history being deleted
symptom: After using xDrip with a Libre sensor and Blucon, the sensor's stored history (last 8 hours) appears to be deleted when scanning with the Libre app, so the clinic cannot see the data via LibreView.
evidence_quote: the libre sensor stores the last 8 hours of 15 min checks itself, but after using xdrip + blucon, when i go to update the libreview app the sensor hasnt got the last 8 hours.
